rationale: A third party (the neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to a hazardous condition (icy walkway), creating a clear premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway in front of policyholder's house during last week's ice storm, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are seeking coverage for medical bills. Pediatric injury on premises warrants high-priority review and damage assessment.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway, broke wrist
